description: Migrate data persistence from ephemeral local JSON files to Firebase (Firestore for data, Storage for images).

userStories.title: Set up Firebase Admin SDK
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Express backend to securely connect to Firebase so that it can read and write to Firestore.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a Firebase initialization module for the backend server

userStories.title: Migrate User Authentication Data to Firestore
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store user data in Firestore instead of users.json to ensure persistence on Vercel.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace users.json reads/writes in server.ts with Firestore 'users' collection operations
Update /api/auth/* endpoints to use the new Firestore logic

userStories.title: Migrate History Data to Firestore
userStories.description: As a user, I want my analysis history saved persistently in the cloud so it is not lost on server restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace history.json and fertilizer_history.json logic with Firestore 'history' collections
Update /api/history and /api/fertilizer/history endpoints to fetch/save from Firestore

userStories.title: Migrate Products Data to Firestore
userStories.description: As a user, I want my marketplace products saved persistently so they remain available to buyers.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace products.json logic with a Firestore 'products' collection
Update all /api/products endpoints (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) to use Firestore

userStories.title: Migrate Image Uploads to Cloud Storage
userStories.description: As a user, I want uploaded images to persist across server restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure Firebase Storage (or similar cloud storage) for image uploads in the backend
Replace local multer upload logic (saving to /uploads) with cloud storage uploads
Update frontend to properly render cloud storage URLs
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
